question: What total domain encompasses all earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: They belong to a complete field-group
inference: The complete field-group comprises all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of sarvakṣetrakam in the larger sentence is incomplete in this verse alone.
plain_english: The entire field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
